The Metropolitan Transportation Authority operates a large regional transportation network serving the New York metropolitan area. The Application Developer designs, codes, tests, documents, and supports software applications across web-based, mobile, or client/server environments while developing technical specifications in compliance with MTA procedures.
Transportation/Trucking/Railroad
